video_prompt: One continuous full-frame close-up shot in a bright Scandinavian room with white walls, light oak slats and soft daylight; the video fills the whole frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman — a woman about 38 years old with fair skin, straight honey-blonde shoulder-length hair tucked behind one ear, wearing a cream cable-knit sweater — wearing black over-ear headphones, speaks into the black podcast microphone, alone in the shot, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera. Locked-off camera on a tripod; the background stays still. The woman talks toward the right, where the other host sits off-camera, confident and knowing, explaining something, with small natural head movements.
